MONEY IN. MONEY OUT. / 02

Payment desk.

Review each request against the actual payment before approving.

Review manual deposits and withdrawals against your payment records. Stripe deposits are credited from verified payment notifications. Withdrawal approval records a completed bank transfer; it does not send one.

A SHARED EDGE / 03

Lead the next play.

Publish a pick to copy it into eligible funded positions.

✳

One pick. A shared position.

The strategy’s allocation rate determines each copied stake. Paused positions and positions without enough available funds are skipped. Copy stakes settle from the same final game score.
